question: Why did Gideon tear down the altar to Baal at night instead of in the daytime?
options: He wanted to hide it from the Midianites
His servants only worked at night
The moon gave him a sign
He was afraid of his family and the townspeople
explanation: Gideon took ten servants and did what the LORD told him, but he did it at night because he was afraid of his family and the townspeople.
